audience.text: Python developers who need to parse OneNote notebooks programmatically to extract pages, rich text, images, tables, attachments, tags, and numbered lists, or to generate PDF documents from OneNote content.

capabilities.text: Load .one files from paths or binary streams into a DOM tree of Page, Outline, OutlineElement, RichText, Image, Table, and AttachedFile nodes.
capabilities.title: Parse OneNote documents

capabilities.text: Read TextRun and TextStyle properties including bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, font, color, and hyperlinks.
capabilities.title: Extract rich text and formatting

capabilities.text: Access Image and AttachedFile nodes to retrieve bytes and file names, enabling saving to disk.
capabilities.title: Extract images and attachments

capabilities.text: Traverse Table, TableRow, TableCell, TableColumn nodes and inspect NoteTag metadata including labels, icons, and status.
capabilities.title: Inspect tables and tags

capabilities.text: Export OneNote pages to PDF using Document.Save with SaveFormat.Pdf and PdfSaveOptions for JPEG quality and image compression control.
capabilities.title: Export to PDF

capabilities.text: Use GetChildNodes for type-based search or DocumentVisitor for full tree traversal of the document structure.
capabilities.title: Traverse document tree

capabilities.text: Read NumberList properties on OutlineElement nodes to determine list format, number format, and restart behavior.
capabilities.title: Inspect numbered lists

capabilities.text: Access Page metadata including Title, Author, CreationTime, LastModifiedTime, and Level, plus revision history via PageHistory.
capabilities.title: Handle document metadata

limitations.text: Writing back to .one files is not implemented — this library only reads OneNote files.
Password-protected documents are not supported — supplying a password raises IncorrectPasswordException.
SaveFormat currently declares only Pdf — Document.Save raises UnsupportedSaveFormatException for any other format or options object.
License.SetLicense() and Metered.SetMeteredKey() are no-ops in this edition — no license is required to use this library.
DetectLayoutChanges() is a compatibility stub and performs no layout computation.
LoadOptions.DocumentPassword is not supported — password-protected documents raise IncorrectPasswordException.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic access to OneNote content without requiring Microsoft OneNote installation or COM automation, supporting cross-platform Python environments.
Provides structured DOM traversal of OneNote documents via Document, Page, Outline, OutlineElement, RichText, Image, Table, and AttachedFile nodes.
Supports extraction of rich text with per-run formatting, hyperlinks, paragraph styles, and OneNote tags attached to text, images, and tables.
Allows conversion of OneNote pages to PDF with configurable JPEG quality and image compression via PdfSaveOptions.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Note FOSS for Python is a free, open-source Python library for reading Microsoft OneNote (.one) files and exporting pages to PDF, with no dependency on Microsoft OneNote or COM automation.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of DetectLayoutChanges() as a compatibility stub is not detailed beyond being a no-op.
The scope of FileFormat values reported by Document.FileFormat is limited to OneNote2010 per examples.
The behavior of Clone() on Page when cloneHistory=True is not elaborated beyond method existence.
The exact structure and content of PageHistory beyond Current, Count, and IsReadOnly is not detailed.
The behavior of Append/Insert/Remove/Replace/Trim methods on RichText is not elaborated beyond method existence.
The exact behavior of Replace() on Image nodes is not elaborated beyond method existence.
The exact behavior of GetNumberedListHeader() on NumberList is not elaborated beyond method existence.
The exact behavior of the FontsSubsystem property in SaveOptions is not elaborated beyond property existence.

workflows.name: Load and inspect OneNote document
workflows.text: Load a .one file using Document, access its DisplayName and page count, and iterate over pages using standard Python iteration.

workflows.name: Extract embedded images
workflows.text: Traverse Image nodes via GetChildNodes, retrieve image bytes and file names, and write them to disk using pathlib.

workflows.name: Parse tables and extract cell content
workflows.text: Iterate over Table, TableRow, TableCell, and RichText nodes to extract text values from table cells.

workflows.name: Export document to PDF
workflows.text: Call Document.Save with SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions to generate a PDF file from a OneNote document.

workflows.name: Inspect numbered lists
workflows.text: Access NumberList properties on OutlineElement nodes to read list format, number format, and restart behavior.

workflows.name: Traverse document using visitor pattern
workflows.text: Subclass DocumentVisitor and override VisitPageStart, VisitRichTextStart, VisitImageStart methods to count or process specific node types.
